'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris O'Hara LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris O'Hara]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' Fullensith
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
